name: Watch Tracker
overview: Per-user show progress, abandon flags and automatic cleanup
description: Tracks who has started and finished each show and season, flags viewers who stopped watching, and removes seasons or shows once everyone who started them has finished. Safe by default: nothing is deleted unless Cleanup mode is set to Delete. Works on Jellyfin 10.11 and 12.x.

versions.changelog: Works on Jellyfin 10.11 and 12.x from one package. Includes all safety features: nothing is deleted unless Cleanup mode is Delete, sizes before deleting, per-run limit, Keep toggles.
Keep toggle for shows and seasons; Delete eligible now only appears in Delete mode.
